contract_scope.purpose: Implementation-ready field-bullet topology for every Stage 2 source spawn carrying a pattern; this does not replace choreography, score-route state, boss phases, or runtime code.
unchanged_source_authority: source primitive, start delay, interval, shots per burst, speed, and routing ID
encounter pause, resume, and clear gates
score-route target order, callback deadlines, topology graph, multipliers, and rewards

segment_topology_identity.normal: Local single-rebound abacus rails resolve into broad, published booth lanes.
segment_topology_identity.hard: The same sources resolve through mirror-opposite booth sides; route order is reflected across x=360 before the next passage opens.

segment_topology_identity.normal: The post-midboss red, blue, yellow flags publish three fixed passages.
segment_topology_identity.hard: The flags retain their published score order while their field passages interleave left, right, center, right, left.

segment_topology_identity.normal: Static booth walls, one adjacent rebound, and a selected mirror leave one broad final passage.
segment_topology_identity.hard: Neighbor flips, selected mirror direction, and surviving-mirror activation form a directed interleaved passage graph without changing score order.

coordinate_contract.angle_convention: Degrees clockwise from positive x in the y-down playfield; 90 degrees points down.
coordinate_contract.geometry_validation: All anchors, route points, surface endpoints, edge segments, and gap centers must be finite and inside combat_bounds. A safe route is the open horizontal interval centered on each ordered gap center; its declared minimum width is inclusive and must remain unobstructed from warning display through the route handoff.

fingerprint_contract.encoding: Seven ASCII components joined by a literal vertical bar in this exact order.
fingerprint_contract.normalization: Identifiers are lowercase ASCII machine IDs. Arrays retain authored order. Numbers are not fingerprint components; changing only count, speed, HP, lifetime, warning, or width can never establish topology differentiation.
fingerprint_contract.validation: Split the stored fingerprint into exactly seven nonempty lowercase ASCII machine components, require component 0 to equal the exact source primitive, require topology IDs and complete fingerprints to be globally unique, and require Normal and Hard to differ. Geometry is validated independently against primitive requirements and behavioral evidence; runtime must not invent semantic component names from numeric coordinates.

bullet_observability_contract.emission_schedule: For field_owned rows, burst 0 is event.authored_tick + source_pattern.start_delay_ticks and burst n is burst 0 + n * source_pattern.interval_ticks while the spawned source entity remains alive and no choreography clear/despawn rule has removed its pattern. Event completion advances scheduling but does not erase an entity carried by later formation.active_entity_ids. Each burst emits exactly source_pattern.shots_per_burst at source_pattern.speed. Topology never changes those source numbers.
bullet_observability_contract.bullet_uid_algorithm: Join stage_run_uid, event_id, bullet_source_spawn_id, emitter_id, zero-based burst_index, and zero-based shot_index with a literal colon. Each input ID must exclude colons. The resulting UTF-8 string is the bullet_uid and is never reused within a stage_run_uid.

required_immutable_source_metadata.shot_index: zero-based non-negative integer less than source shots_per_burst
required_immutable_source_metadata.collision_enable_tick: exact integer tick derived from collision_activation

mutable_observation_state.reflection_count: starts at zero and increments exactly once per authored rebound_turn waypoint reached; it is a piecewise-turn count, not evidence of specular collision physics
mutable_observation_state.first_reflection_tick: null until the first accepted reflection, then immutable
mutable_observation_state.last_reflection_surface_id: null until reflection, then exact profile surface ID
mutable_observation_state.graze_tick: reported by the consumer; it never rewrites source metadata

approved_main_seam_mapping.mapping_status: Exact adapter contract only; this content artifact does not implement or claim visibility of the consumer fields.

stage2_routing.write_rule: immutable exact source pattern routing ID

stage2_reflection_count.write_rule: initialize to 0 and increment exactly once at each authored rebound_turn

required_consumer_extensions.implementation_status: Required of the later consumer; absent from and not fabricated by this content ticket.

stage2_last_reflection_surface_id.write_rule: null before a rebound_turn, then the exact bound reflection_surface_id

required_consumer_extensions.literal_name_rule: The consumer must use these exact stage2_* keys. It may not rename them to a near synonym, infer missing timing from bullet age, or report an unbound surface alias; absence fails the observability adapter closed.

bullet_observability_contract.score_route_callback_projection: A qualifying rebound graze forwards stage_run_uid, difficulty, stage_tick, event_sequence, event_id, bullet_uid, bullet_source_spawn_id, bullet_spawn_tick, first_reflection_tick, reflection_count_before_graze, and graze_tick exactly as required by m2_stage2_score_route_contract_v1. Only bullets whose source event, source spawn, primitive, and reflection count match that contract may qualify.
bullet_observability_contract.idempotency: Emission is keyed by bullet_uid; reflection is keyed by [bullet_uid, reflection_count, surface_id, tick]; a repeated emission, reflection, or graze observation is ignored and emits duplicate telemetry without duplicating gameplay or score effects.

rebound_bead.emitter_rule: Resolve the named emitter anchor at each burst. aim_rule and activation_order choose an ordered route family, then assign shot i to ordered_routes[i modulo ordered_routes.size]. The exact execution heading is the vector from route point 0 to point 1 at source speed; optional authored angle arrays describe telegraph/fan ordering but never override the exact route vector. Player position cannot be read unless aim_rule.mode explicitly says player_locked_at_bullet_spawn.
rebound_bead.reflection_rule: ordered_routes is the authoritative non-specular piecewise-linear path: point 0 is the emitter, each following reflection_surface_id binds by index to the next route point as one authored rebound_turn, and the final point is the terminus. Move at source speed toward the current point; on exact arrival at a rebound_turn, retain speed, set heading directly toward the next authored point, increment both turn_count and reflection_count exactly once, latch first_reflection_tick on turn 1, and emit the bound surface ID. No angle-of-incidence, surface normal, BulletWorld bound, or generic reflect-vector calculation changes that authored outgoing heading. reflection_surfaces.segment is the visible finite telegraph span and normal is visual facing only; neither claims specular physics.
rebound_bead.turn_count_rule: turn_count and reflection_count both start at 0. Each internal route point bound to reflection_surface_ids increments both exactly once; unbound terminal arrival increments neither. A bullet destroyed before its first bound point remains at 0 and cannot satisfy a rebound-graze predicate. max_reflections must equal the greatest bound rebound_turn count of any selected route.
rebound_bead.warning_rule: At bullet_spawn_tick - warning_lead_ticks, draw the complete ordered route as a noncolliding preview, including every surface ID and at least the source event future_path_px when nonzero.
rebound_bead.lifetime_rule: For each route compute travel_ticks = sum(Euclidean distance between consecutive authored points) * tick_rate / source_pattern.speed. source speed must be positive and travel_ticks must be strictly less than selected lifetime_ticks, which is bounded to 360. Leaving combat_bounds before the authored terminus destroys the bullet without inventing a turn.
rebound_bead.malformed_routing_fallback: Reject configuration; never replace the route with aimed, spread, downward, playfield-bound reflection, or the opposite difficulty profile.

grid_edge.emitter_rule: For shot i, select edge_segments[i modulo edge_segments.size], place it at fraction (floor(i / edge_segments.size) + 1) / (ceil(shots_per_burst / edge_segments.size) + 1) along the segment, and launch along its declared travel_angle_deg at source speed.
grid_edge.warning_rule: Render every segment in activation_order as a noncolliding dashed booth edge at bullet_spawn_tick - warning_lead_ticks. A segment becomes eligible to emit only at its declared activation slot.
grid_edge.collision_rule: Dashed preview geometry never collides. Only emitted bullets collide from collision_enable_tick; edge lines are authoring guides, not persistent collision bodies.
grid_edge.lifetime_rule: Linear edge bullets are destroyed at route terminus, combat-bound exit, or 300 ticks, whichever occurs first.
grid_edge.malformed_routing_fallback: Reject configuration; never collapse an edge set to a generic downward stream or infer missing segments from spawn x.

lane_fan.emitter_rule: Resolve the base angle once at bullet_spawn_tick, then add fan_offsets_deg[shot_index]. fixed_lane_center aims at the declared lane center at y=936; fixed_angle uses its authored angle; player_locked_at_bullet_spawn samples player center exactly once and never retargets.
lane_fan.passage_rule: lane_sequence is the default structural state: burst n uses lane_sequence[n modulo lane_sequence.size]. When lane_sequence_by_state is present, atomically select its ordered array from the declared emission state before assigning any shot in the burst; the state cannot change midway through a burst. The chosen lane changes emitter/aim composition and gap order, not source speed, count, or schedule.
lane_fan.warning_rule: At bullet_spawn_tick - warning_lead_ticks, show every fan boundary and highlight the selected lane/gap for that burst without collision.
lane_fan.lifetime_rule: Fan bullets are destroyed on combat-bound exit or at 300 ticks.
lane_fan.malformed_routing_fallback: Reject configuration; never substitute a generic spread, aimed fan, or downward fan.

delayed_seed.emitter_rule: Create each seed at its assigned seed_positions slot with zero velocity and collision disabled. Assign ordered_routes by shot index, replace that route's point 0 with the selected seed position, and store the resulting piecewise-linear route and first-segment launch velocity at bullet_spawn_tick. At bullet_spawn_tick + activation_delay_ticks, enable collision and follow the stored route at source speed; never reread player aim.
delayed_seed.activation_rule: shot i uses seed_activation_order[i modulo seed_activation_order.size]; duplicate slots are invalid. Dormant seeds remain visible and noncolliding. Activation ties retain seed_activation_order.
delayed_seed.warning_rule: The route and activation ordinal are visible no later than warning_lead_ticks before collision enable.
delayed_seed.lifetime_rule: Lifetime includes dormancy and is bounded to 360 ticks; activation_delay_ticks must be positive and less than lifetime_ticks.
delayed_seed.malformed_routing_fallback: Reject configuration; never activate immediately, never retarget on activation, and never substitute rebound_bead.

ordered_operations: switch blue emission state to post_red

scheduled_emission_state_machine.same_tick_order_rule: A burst callback with lower event_sequence than the red defeat uses pre_red; one with higher event_sequence uses post_red. The state cannot change midway through one burst.
scheduled_emission_state_machine.no_emission_suppression: Every source-scheduled burst fires exactly once. Missing or late red defeat leaves blue in executable pre_red and never delays, drops, or invents a burst.

scheduled_emission_state_machine.pre_mirror_revision_rule: Red and blue defeat transforms update the tracked score topology revision atomically but do not change the executable pre_mirror right-lane cap or source burst schedule.

atomic_mapping_transition.trigger_callback: exactly one selected mirror defeat accepted and mirror row frozen
ordered_operations: freeze the exact selected mirror table row
publish that state's lane, activation, and safe-gap order before the next higher event_sequence burst

scheduled_emission_state_machine.same_tick_order_rule: A burst callback with lower event_sequence than accepted mirror selection uses pre_mirror; one with higher event_sequence uses the fully mapped state. The state cannot change midway through one burst.
scheduled_emission_state_machine.no_selection_rule: If no unique mirror is accepted, keep the executable pre_mirror right-lane cap for gameplay while the score-route contract expires or invalidates mirror choice; never suppress a scheduled burst or assume a mapped lane.
scheduled_emission_state_machine.no_emission_suppression: Every source-scheduled burst fires exactly once in the state selected at its callback event_sequence.

event_budgets.behavioral_evidence: Route traces must show left-source-to-right-lane and right-source-to-left-lane crossings only on Hard, with the center activation after those crossed legs.

malformed_routing_policy.preflight: Validate source hashes, exact spawn coverage, unique IDs, source bindings, primitive schemas, geometry bounds, fingerprint recomputation, warning floors, safe widths, lifetimes, score-topology references, and event caps atomically before Stage 2 starts.
malformed_routing_policy.fail_closed_result: On any failure, reject the whole field topology contract, emit a stable hard_error code and offending event/spawn/profile path, schedule zero field bullets, register zero score-route bullet callbacks, and leave the stage wave clock unstarted.
malformed_routing_policy.runtime_fault_after_preflight: Latch a hard error, cancel all not-yet-emitted field bullets, clear field-owned hostile bullets, invalidate every unsettled route group with topology_predicate_failed, and preserve already-settled score multipliers exactly as the score-route contract requires. Encounter gate tokens and boss phases are never fabricated.
malformed_routing_policy.gameplay_only_route_fallbacks: Only the two well-formed choreography fallbacks remain legal: abacus-before-surviving-mirror in s2_b16 and wrong-order outer crossing in s2_b18. They continue gameplay but cannot settle a score group or spawn night_festival_seal; malformed data never enters these fallbacks.

invariants.rule: spawn_topologies contains exactly one row for every choreography spawn whose pattern is present: 22 rows across 10 events, with no extra event or spawn ID.

Every row exactly matches source event, segment, enemy, position, movement, primitive, routing, schedule, speed, drops, warning, hooks, and encounter gate data. Profiles may only supply missing topology geometry.
The contract adds no events, waves, enemies, drops, controls, rewards, HP, score predicates, or phase definitions.

Each row has exactly normal and hard. Their topology IDs and canonical seven-part fingerprints differ in at least one emitter, route/edge, aim composition, activation order, reflection/delay route, or ordered-gap component; numeric-only changes do not qualify.

Every covered pattern event has a behavioral_evidence test based on emitted route, surface, edge, lane, activation, or delegated topology records rather than bullet totals, source text, or file existence.

Every field-owned Normal profile declares at least 112 px and every field-owned Hard profile at least 84 px. Event budgets retain the stricter segment floors 144/108, 128/96, and 112/84 where applicable.
Every field-owned Normal warning is at least 12 ticks and every Hard warning is at least 8 ticks; this artifact retains the source event lead on both difficulties.
Every field-owned bullet has a positive lifetime no greater than its primitive cap. phase_owned has lifetime 0 because it emits no field bullets.

No event budget exceeds 156 Normal or 204 Hard active bullets. Runtime must reject a schedule whose conservative carryover estimate exceeds its event budget or the stage cap; it may not silently truncate a burst.
Hard s2_b01, s2_b02, and s2_b05 use opposite-x booth surfaces or crossed outer legs, with activation and gap orders that cannot be reproduced by changing count, speed, or width.
Hard s2_b04, s2_b12, s2_b13, s2_b15, and s2_b16 alternate owner, lane, graph revision, mirror preview, seed order, or conditional surface before reopening the next passage.

Published red-blue-yellow order, rebound UID qualification, neighbor transforms, mirror transform table, surviving-mirror comparison, final_open_lane_algorithm, multiplier progression, and exactly-one night_festival_seal remain exclusively defined by m2_stage2_score_route_contract_v1.
A rebound graze cannot qualify before first_reflection_tick, with reflection_count_before_graze less than 1, from the wrong event/spawn/primitive, or from an unvalidated topology fingerprint.

Given the frozen source artifacts, stage_run_uid, difficulty, ordered player samples required by the score topology, and ordered defeat callbacks, emission IDs, routes, surface impacts, activation order, warnings, and score projections are identical across reset, seek, and snapshot restore.
Unknown or malformed routing is a hard configuration error with zero generic-alias output and zero score callbacks; a partial contract can never run.
s2_b06 still pauses and clears into the two approved midboss phases, s2_b12 resumes only after both phase tokens and clears hostile bullets, and s2_b18 remains the boss-front completion gate.
